life.immortal_cultivation_mod.map.travel: A collapsed mountain road blocks the caravan. A wounded cultivator blames a beast, while the caravan leader calls him a bandit scout.
Help the wounded cultivator
You treat the stranger and gain a grateful guide, though the delay costs strength.
Search the surrounding slopes
Tracks reveal a hidden cache and the true path around the collapse.
Continue without stopping
The caravan leaves the dispute behind and reaches the route safely.
Seize the cultivator's storage bag
You take the bag and leave him behind; wealth rises together with local suspicion.
Bandits surround the road and demand payment after displaying captured travelers.
Break through by force
You defeat the ambush and recover part of the stolen cargo.
Pay the demanded toll
The bandits accept payment and let the journey pass unharmed.
Abandon the road and flee
You escape through rough ground, shaken but alive.
Negotiate for the captives
Careful words split the bandits and open a route without a full battle.
A spirit storm twists Qi, weather, and direction across the route.
Shelter until it passes
The safe delay carries the journey into the next annual segment.
Force a path through
You cross through injury and gain hard-won combat experience.
Study the storm's circulation
The pattern wounds your focus but yields rare comprehension.
Harvest concentrated Qi
You seize dense Qi at personal risk and continue with greater cultivation.
A broken seal reveals forbidden cargo hidden within the caravan.
Report the cargo
Authorities reward your report and seize the shipment.
Ignore it
The cargo remains hidden and the journey continues quietly.
Join the transaction
You earn a share of the illicit profit at a moral cost.
Confiscate it yourself
You take the cargo by force, gaining valuables and local enemies.
A great flying beast shadows the route and dives toward the travelers.
Repel the beast
You drive it away after a costly aerial fight.
Evade through cloud cover
The journey escapes, though the chase strains everyone's nerves.
Attempt to tame it
You endure its attacks and form a bond with a new spirit mount.
Follow it off route
It leads you toward rumors of the hidden Guixu Islands.
A teleportation array tears open at the wrong coordinates as its spatial anchors fail.
Stabilize the formation
You repair the anchor and arrive with new spatial insight.
Endure the distortion
The passage injures you but still reaches its destination.
Abort the teleport
The array closes safely, delaying the journey.
Observe the broken coordinates
You study the failure and gather cultivation insight before landing.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jingling_: Creates a 1,000-point mirror shield for up to 20 seconds. Compatible spell projectiles consume another 200 qi and return toward their caster at 80% damage; attacks that cannot be reflected damage the shield.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yuangang_: Maintains a moving spherical domain that protects allied entities through one shared shield pool. Its cost, radius, and durability scale through the three Nascent Soul stages, and hostile projectiles are slowed within it.
Vast primordial qi opens into a heavenly sphere; all companions beneath it share one unbroken defense.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jinmang_c: Compresses metal qi into an extremely narrow, high-speed projectile. It penetrates up to three enemies, loses 20% damage after each target, ignores 30% of armor defense, and deals 50% extra damage to shields.
One thread of golden radiance gathers to a point; armor splits only after the light has passed.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jinfeng_z: Fires an extremely narrow golden projectile for 28 damage on impact. It ignores 10% of defense and deals 25% extra shield damage, but its thin hitbox makes misses costly.
Two fingers gather a golden edge; one fine ray parts armor before the eye can follow.
item.immortal_cultivation_mod.wanren_chu: Myriad Blades Pierce the Heart Scroll
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wanren_ch: Forms six spiritual metal blades around the caster and launches them from different angles. Each deals 110 damage and ignores 15% of defense; after the first hit marks a target, the remaining blades gain homing.
Six blades circle like stars; the first draws blood, and all the rest remember the heart.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jingji_tu: Fires an invisible trigger that erupts spiritual thorns in a 2.5-block radius on impact, dealing 40 damage, launching targets slightly upward, and slowing them by 20% for 2 seconds. It cannot reach enemies high above the ground.
A thought enters the soil; green spears answer beneath the enemy's feet.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wanteng_j: Fires an invisible trigger that summons a five-block snare for 5 seconds on impact. Vines pull enemies inward, slow them by 60%, and deal 90 damage each second. Fire techniques rapidly destroy the formation.
Ten thousand vines knot into one prison; roots tighten until breath itself is bound.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yanbao_da: Throws an unstable fire orb. A direct hit deals 65 damage, its three-block explosion deals up to 35 more, and affected enemies burn for 3 seconds.
Fire is folded into one restless pearl; release the hand, and scarlet ruin blossoms.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.chiyan_lo: Fires an invisible trigger that creates a slowly advancing pillar of spiritual flame for 5 seconds on impact. The eight-block-tall tornado draws enemies and loose objects within six blocks inward, deals 180 damage each second inside its four-block core, tears a wide path through terrain as it moves, and throws survivors outward when it ends.
Scarlet wind coils from earth to heaven; flame draws all things inward, then casts ash away.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.diyan_qia: Fires an invisible trigger that drives a stone spear from below its impact, dealing 55 damage and launching targets upward. Landing back on solid ground deals another 20 damage.
The mountain hides a spear; at one command, stone rises and the foe falls twice.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shanbeng_: Fires an invisible trigger. Its impact warns for 1.5 seconds before a huge mountain seal falls across six blocks. It deals up to 900 damage with edge falloff, gains 50% damage against grounded targets, crushes them downward, and blasts out a massive deep crater. Full charge makes the destruction wider, deeper, and able to break harder blocks.
A seal borrows the weight of peaks; shadow arrives first, then mountain and earth become one.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shuiren_l: Launches three slightly spread water-crescent projectiles. Each deals 12 damage, for 36 total if all connect, and extinguishes burning targets.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.canglang_: Sends a seven-block-wide wave forward for 14 blocks. It deals 180 damage once, carries enemies with it, knocks them away at the end, and extinguishes fire and burning terrain.
The vast tide crosses the field in one breath; foes and flame alike are swept from its path.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.leishan.d: Becomes a lightning streak and instantly dashes up to eight blocks without passing through walls. Enemies crossed take 55 damage, while the caster receives 50% less damage during the brief transformation.
Thunder leaves no footstep; a white line passes, and only then does the wound speak.
item.immortal_cultivation_mod.wulei_hong: Five Thunderbolts Crown the Target Scroll

The first thunder writes the name; four heavenly judgments follow the same mark.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.bingzhui_: Fires an invisible trigger that creates eight OBJ-rendered ice spikes above a four-block area on impact. Each falling spike deals 30 damage and adds 5% slow, stacking to 30%.
Cold stars gather above; eight crystal points descend and winter follows each wound.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.hanyu_fen: Freezes a seven-block radius for 6 seconds, dealing 100 damage each second and slowing enemies by 35%. Remaining inside for 4 seconds freezes a target for 1 second. Fire techniques rapidly break the frozen domain.
One breath seals seven paces; linger beneath the frost, and even thought becomes still.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yaoguang_: Releases a six-block flash that deals 20 damage and blinds enemies for 2.5 seconds, interrupting mobs focused on the caster. Undead and dark-aligned enemies take 50 damage instead.
Radiance opens like a second sun; hostile eyes lose the path, and shadows burn deepest.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.tianguang: Fires an invisible trigger that marks its impact for 1 second, then sends a two-block-wide pillar through every enemy in its vertical path for 950 damage. The heavenly beam bores a long vertical shaft through terrain; full charge widens and greatly extends the channel. Dark-aligned targets take 25% more.
A pale mark invites heaven's gaze; one pillar descends, and every shadow in its path is pierced.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yingxi.de: Fires an invisible trigger. When it strikes a visible enemy, the caster melts into shadow for 0.3 seconds and appears behind them. The strike deals 70 damage, or 100 from behind, and cannot cross thick walls or forcefields.
The shadow leaves before the body; when the foe turns, the blade is already behind the heart.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.tianfeng_: Fires an invisible trigger that crushes a five-block area on impact for 600 damage and drives a broad crater into the impact zone. Flying targets are forced violently downward and suffer up to 300 impact damage; grounded targets are briefly knocked down. Full charge produces a much larger and deeper crater.
Heavenly wind becomes an unseen hammer; wings fold, knees break, and the sky returns its prey to earth.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.muling_sh: Sneak-cast to fill yourself with life energy, or cast normally to fire an invisible healing projectile at an ally. Restores 140 HP over 8 seconds while moving and fighting. Burning halves each healing pulse. Cannot stack with itself.
A breath of green enters the meridians; wounds close even while steel still rings.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.xue_guiyu: Sneak-cast on yourself or cast normally to fire an invisible healing projectile at an ally. Removes heavy bleeding, restores 120 HP instantly, then 100 HP over 5 seconds. Targets below 5% HP are stabilized by the same cast before healing begins.
Scattered blood answers the origin; severed currents join, and the fading pulse becomes whole.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shengxi_b: Instantly restores 35% of the caster's missing HP. The self-only heal is at least 100 HP and at most 250 HP.
Stored spring erupts in one breath; the emptier the vessel, the stronger life returns.
message.immortal_cultivation_mod.xue_gui: The target is stabilized and Blood Returns to Origin begins healing.

A tender blossom follows the wandering wind; four turns bind the body, then every soft petal reveals its edge.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.pokong_ji: Requires a sword. The blade has already passed while one silver line remains; space parts a breath later, and two lives answer the same edge.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.sanjian_z: Requires a sword. Fires an invisible trigger; when it strikes an enemy, three spiritual swords form around the caster: one attacks directly, one curves from the left, and one descends from above. One sword asks the path, two swords seal escape; when three silver traces meet, fate has nowhere left to turn.

guidance.immortal_cultivation_mod.chapte: Chapter 0 · Mortal Awakening
Before sensing Qi, a mortal must first awaken the body's potential with an Enlightenment Pill.
Find an Enlightenment Pill
Follow the cave bearing %s for %s blocks to X: %s, Z: %s. Search its chest for the pill.

Chapter 1 · First Steps
Heaven and earth hold spirit. First know yourself, then awaken the sense of Qi.
Examine your cultivation state
Press [%s] to open cultivation stats. The highlighted fields show realm, spirit root, vitality, and lifespan.
Enter Qi Refining
Consume an Enlightenment Pill and complete awakening to sense the world's Qi.
Chapter 2 · Drawing Qi Within
Draw worldly Qi through the meridians and settle it within the dantian.
Absorb Qi while meditating
Press [%s] and genuinely absorb 100 Qi. Denser-Qi locations recover it faster.
Activate a cultivation method
Learn and activate the provided Basic Breathing Method. Methods affect cultivation speed, Qi recovery, affinity, and breakthroughs.
Chapter 3 · First Techniques
A learned spell must be equipped, selected, and cast through the real spell system.
Learn your first spell
Study the provided Wind Blade scroll through its learning challenge.
Equip the spell to the wheel
Press [%s], then add a learned spell to the spell wheel.
Cast the equipped spell
Use [%s] for the spell wheel and [%s] to cast the selected spell.
Release a spell at 150% charge
Hold [%s], then release after charge reaches at least 150%%.
Build spell proficiency
Practice advances real proficiency: Beginner → Minor Success → Major Success → Perfection → Peak.
Chapter 4 · Spiritual Sense
Eyes perceive form; spiritual sense perceives life, Qi, formations, and intent.
Release spiritual sense
Press [%s] to toggle spiritual sense and let its perception sphere expand.
Sense a living being outside sight
Detect a real living signature through an obstruction. Concealment and distance resist you.
Chapter 5 · Cultivator Combat
Cultivator combat alternates weapons, movement, spells, defense, and Qi control.
Land a weapon attack
Press [%s] for combat mode, then land a real weapon hit. A cultivator's Interact → Spar option provides safe practice.
Use a weapon technique
Charge and land a heavy attack with any weapon, including vanilla weapons, or use a weapon-specific technique.
Cast during combat
Create an opening and press [%s] to cast a learned technique successfully.
Use a charged combat spell
Hold [%s] and release a technique at 150%% charge while fighting.
Keep a safe Qi reserve
Cast successfully without allowing Qi to fall below 20%.
Recognize an enemy attack
Block or survive a projectile/telegraphed technique instead of ignoring it.
Chapter 6 · Storage and Equipment
Equipment belongs in its proper slot; storage pouches and protective accessories each have their own controls.
Equip a cultivation item
Place suitable armor or clothing into its real equipment slot.
Open a Qi pouch
Use a Qi pouch to enter its top-down internal-space interface.
Place a block inside
Drag a valid block into the real buildable internal space.
Remove a placed block
Double-click a placed block to return it to your inventory.
Chapter 7 · Spiritual Veins
Worldly Qi gathers into underground currents whose centers empower cultivation.
Detect a spiritual vein
Use spiritual sense until an actual vein signature enters perception.
Reach the vein center
Follow the sensed Qi flow and stand within four blocks of its center.
Chapter 8 · Artifact Forging
Complete a real forging process: recipe, materials, flame, temperature, melting, and the finished item. Higher-grade materials require stronger flames.
Open a forge ding
Interact with a placed ding to open its forging interface.
Add the required materials
Fill the highlighted material slots with the recipe's real ingredients.
Insert the recipe jade slip
Place the matching recipe slip into the highlighted recipe slot.
Raise and control temperature
Begin forging and pulse the fire toward the displayed target range.
Maintain the melt
Keep the forge active while its real melting progress advances.
Complete the forged item
Finish a successful forging cycle and produce its actual output.
Chapter 9 · Recipe Jade Slips
Complex recipes are carried by jade slips and used by their proper system.
Use a recipe jade slip
Learn a spell scroll or use a forging jade slip in a real recipe.
Chapter 10 · Formations
Craft the Magic Ritual Guide from a Book and Low-Grade Spirit Stone. Formation cultivators carry the Ritual Dagger needed to build formations.
Place a blank Magic Center
Shift-right-click with a Ritual Dagger, choose a radius, and place the center beneath you. It records you as its owner.
Complete a valid circle pattern
Right-click with the Ritual Dagger to draw the circles required by a diagram in the Magic Ritual Guide.
Transform the center
Strike the completed center with the Ritual Dagger to transform it into the matched formation.
Chapter 11 · Formation Flags
Flags modify an existing formation; their tooltips retain exact effects.
Open the octagon flag tab
Open a center, then select its highlighted octagon tab.
Install a formation flag
Insert a real formation flag into one highlighted octagon slot.
Chapter 12 · The Cultivation World
Cultivators possess identity, realm, relationships, inventory, and goals.
Speak with a cultivator
Interact with a real cultivator NPC and choose a dialogue option.
Complete an NPC trade
Inspect the NPC's inventory and complete one valid exchange.
Accept an NPC task
Accept one actual quest from a cultivator.
Chapter 13 · Breakthrough
A breakthrough opens only after meeting the current stage requirements. Some major realms have separate trials, with lasting consequences for failure.
Reach the current realm limit
Fill cultivation progress and Qi; required pills and method limits still apply.
Begin a breakthrough
Open cultivation stats and use the highlighted breakthrough control.
Succeed in the breakthrough
Complete the actual breakthrough or Golden Core trial successfully.
Chapter 14 · Foundation Establishment
Foundation Establishment brings sustained techniques, mobility, defense, and outward Qi.
Reach Foundation Establishment
Advance to Foundation Establishment through the real breakthrough path.
Release external Qi through a weapon
Use [%s] to enable and release real outward weapon Qi.
Sustain controlled combat for 60 seconds
Remain in combat for 60 seconds without letting Qi fall below 20%.
Chapter 15 · Flight
Take off, maintain control, and recover the artifact that carried you.
Take flight
Use an available flying sword or Golden Core flight to leave the ground.
Remain airborne for 10 seconds
Maintain real controlled flight continuously.
Recall a flying weapon
Call a released flying sword back under your control or into its case.
Chapter 16 · Golden Core
Qi condenses into a core, improving spiritual sense and unlocking Golden Core systems. Failed tribulation can leave a cultivator at Half-step Golden Core.
Form a Golden Core
Complete the Golden Core challenge and survive its tribulation.
Use strengthened spiritual sense
Release spiritual sense after reaching Golden Core and observe its clearer reach.
Enter Golden Core inner space
Use the Golden Core control in cultivation stats to enter the real pocket dimension.
Side Path · Corpse Arts
A concealed path involving resentment, corpses, refinement, coffins, and control.
Discover an entry to corpse cultivation
Obtain or use a genuine corpse-path item; its deeper branches unlock contextually.

guidance.immortal_cultivation_mod.chapte: 炼器支篇 · 特殊火种
天地异火各有性质，并非所有火焰都适合炼制同一种器物。
发现一种特殊火种
在世界中找到任意特殊火种，并靠近到能够辨认它的位置。
辨认火种
观察火焰的名称、颜色、强度与特性。八种特殊火种拥有不同的外观与炼器能力。
查看火种来源

赤炎火：赤鳞炎蜥掉落，或用赤鳞与火蜥血炼制。
地肺火：地下岩浆与山中地火口。
青木灵火：成熟灵木遭雷击。
金阳真火：金丹以上金／火修士，或遗迹与道观。
幽冥阴火：高阶亡灵与古墓。
雷炎：兵器天劫雷击岩浆或火焰。
蛟龙炎：赤霄炎蛟掉落，或用蛟角与元婴妖丹炼制。
紫霄天火：成功渡过强大兵器天劫后极罕见出现。
确认炼器需求
查看一个需要特殊火种的炼器配方。目标温度超过当前火焰能力时，炼制无法正常进行。
使用更强的火种
找到能够达到目标温度的火种，并用于一次炼器。
炼器支篇 · 火种瓶
火种瓶能够暂时收纳天地灵火，也能直接释放其中的力量。
制作一个火种瓶
按照配方制作一个空火种瓶。
收取火种
手持空火种瓶，对准可收取的悬浮火焰右键，将火种收入瓶中。
查看瓶中火种
查看火种瓶提示，确认其中储存的火焰种类、火力、稳定度与可炼品阶。瓶中火种不会因发射而耗尽。
释放火种
手持装有火种的火种瓶，潜行右键，将火焰释放到指定位置。
发射火焰
直接右键火种瓶，消耗灵气发射一次火焰攻击。
蓄力火种
按住右键蓄力，使火焰逐渐凝聚；发射时消耗灵气。灵气不足时无法继续蓄力。
释放巨型火球
蓄力后松开右键释放巨型火球；持续蓄满时会自动发射。蓄力攻击需要更多灵气。
炼器支篇 · 灵火炼器
火焰不仅决定炉温，也决定某些材料是否能够真正熔化。
将火种放在鼎下
用装有火种的火种瓶向有支撑的空地发射火焰，再将炼器鼎放在火焰正上方。潜行右键释放的是可收取的悬浮火种，不是鼎下燃烧的火焰。
观察炉温
打开炼器鼎，查看当前火种能够提供的温度。
更换合适火种
若炉温无法达到配方要求，更换更强或更适合的火种。
维持灵火
地面灵火会逐渐消散；直接位于炼器鼎下方时燃烧更久。悬浮的可收取火种不会按此计时消失。
使用灵火完成炼制
利用特殊火种成功完成一次完整炼器。
战斗支篇 · 巨型火球
高度凝聚的灵火拥有远超普通术法的破坏力。
蓄力火种瓶
按住装有火种的火种瓶右键，直到形成大型火球；松开右键发射，持续蓄满时会自动发射。发射需要足够灵气。
命中目标区域
释放巨型火球，并让爆炸实际影响目标区域。
观察爆炸范围
巨型火球能够同时伤害范围内的多个生灵。
观察地形破坏
爆炸能够摧毁地形，并影响范围内的液体。
查看方块破坏设置
在修炼设置的“方块破坏”中关闭火种瓶地形破坏。关闭后攻击仍可伤害生灵，但不会摧毁地形。
兵器支篇 · 禁制与晋阶
真正的灵兵并非一次铸成。禁制需要一层层刻入兵器，最终形成完整循环。
查看兵器禁制
查看一件可成长灵兵当前拥有的禁制层数与晋阶进度。
添加一层禁制
通过对应炼器系统成功为兵器刻入一次禁制。
完成一轮禁制
继续强化兵器，直到当前禁制循环全部完成。
尝试兵器晋阶
完成一轮禁制后，在兵器强化界面启动晋阶；晋阶会直接开始兵器天劫。
引发兵器天劫
真正的灵兵晋阶会引来天雷。准备好持兵渡劫，或承担兵器自身被雷劫击中的风险。
兵器支篇 · 兵器渡劫
灵兵欲更进一步，必须经受天雷淬炼。人可以替兵器承劫，兵器也可以自行受劫。
开始兵器渡劫
完成兵器晋阶条件，并主动开始雷劫。
手持兵器承劫
雷劫降下时保持手持目标兵器。天雷会优先由持有者承受。
在雷劫中存活
抵挡连续天雷，直到兵器完成渡劫。
了解脱手后果
若兵器没有被任何人持有，雷劫将直接击中兵器，并损失其耐久。
防止兵器破碎
兵器耐久归零时会破碎。渡劫前应确保兵器状态足以承受雷劫。
了解死亡后果
兵器渡劫期间若持有者死亡，渡劫兵器必定掉落在世界中，即使开启了 keepInventory。
兵器支篇 · 兵器碎片
灵兵虽然会毁，却不会完全消失。残留碎片仍记得自己曾经属于哪一件兵器。
获得一块兵器碎片
让一件灵兵破碎，或找到其他来源的兵器碎片。
辨认碎片
查看碎片信息。兵器碎片会保留能够辨认其原本兵器的信息。
收集完整碎片
收集重铸该兵器所需的全部对应碎片。
准备重铸材料
除完整碎片外，准备两组灵石。
重铸灵兵
在对应炼器系统中使用完整碎片与两组灵石，将破碎兵器重新铸成。
将碎片用于炼器
若不准备复原原兵器，也可以把部分兵器碎片作为其他炼器配方的材料。
突破支篇 · 金丹失败与恢复
结丹失败并不一定意味着重新筑基。有些修士虽然丹未成，却已经跨出了半步。
金丹试炼失败
金丹雷劫中死亡后，查看裂丹与半步金丹的真实后果。本支篇在出现裂丹后开启，无须故意失败。
查看裂开的金丹
打开修炼状态。金丹雷劫中死亡会留下裂开的金丹，并进入半步金丹状态。
查看恢复条件
查看裂丹状态下重新冲击金丹所需的恢复条件。
修复突破状态
半步金丹需要积累筑基后期两倍的修炼进度，并满足界面列出的其他突破条件。
再次冲击金丹
准备完成后重新启动金丹试炼。此前失败不会自动视为突破成功。
丹道支篇 · 丹药使用
丹药的作用不止恢复气血。不同丹药可能影响突破、灵气、身体状态或特殊系统。
获得一枚丹药
获得任意拥有修炼效果的丹药。
查看丹药说明
查看丹药的用途、持续时间与触发条件。
使用一枚丹药
在符合使用条件时服下一枚丹药。
触发丹药效果
让丹药的实际效果至少生效一次。
认识条件型丹药
部分丹药不会在服下瞬间产生全部作用，而会在突破、受伤、灵气不足或其他指定条件出现时触发。
查看剩余效果
打开状态界面，确认当前仍在生效的丹药效果及剩余时间。
神魂支篇 · 念头与控制抵抗
修士面对神识压制、幻术与控制时，可以消耗念头保持自我。
承受一次控制效果
受到一次会消耗念头的控制能力影响。
使用念头抵抗
在控制持续期间消耗念头，减轻或挣脱控制。
观察念头消耗
查看念头随着抵抗持续下降。
耗尽念头
念头耗尽后将无法继续抵抗控制，后续控制更加危险。阅读本提示即可，无须故意耗尽念头。
恢复念头
脱离控制与持续消耗后，让念头重新恢复。
保留念头
面对多个控制型敌人时，不应在第一次控制中耗尽全部念头。
世间支篇 · 人生模拟
修士的人生并不只有闭关与战斗。一次选择，也可能改变之后获得的机缘。
开始一次人生模拟
进入人生模拟系统并创建一次新的模拟。
做出一次选择
阅读发生的事件，并选择其中一个行动。
完成多次事件
继续进行模拟，让此前的决定影响之后的人生。
查看模拟奖励
达到结算条件后查看本次模拟能够获得的奖励。
使用手动结算
在允许结算时主动选择“手动结算”，提前结束当前模拟。
领取模拟结果
确认结算并获得本次人生模拟产生的实际奖励。
世间支篇 · 发型台
修行之路漫长，修士的外貌也并非永远不变。
打开发型台
与放置的发型台交互。
更换发型
从可用发型中选择一种新的样式，并预览角色外观。
调整发色
修改当前头发颜色，并观察实时预览。
使用皮肤参考
载入可用的皮肤参考，使发型与角色皮肤能够正确配合。
保存外观
确认修改，让新的发型与颜色实际应用到角色。
装备支篇 · 护身饰品
护身饰品不占用普通护甲位置，却能在满足条件时提供特殊效果。
打开护身饰品栏
打开角色装备界面并找到护身饰品栏位。
装备镇运铜钱
将镇运铜钱放入有效饰品栏。遭遇可抵挡的厄运时，它会消耗自身保护你。
装备破法戒
将破法戒放入戒指栏，用近战攻击命中正在格挡的敌人，触发破盾效果。
装备血煞牙坠
将血煞牙坠放入项链栏。血魔功法修士或活尸携带血液、血晶，在血气或怨气不足时让它自动补充一次。
装备悟道叶
将悟道叶放入护符栏，通过打坐修炼功法或练习术法，触发熟练度增益。
更换护身饰品
根据当前敌人、修炼方式或目标更换饰品，而不是始终使用同一套装备。
装备一件护身饰品
打开装备界面，将任意护身饰品放入对应饰品栏位。
检查所需火种
查看目标温度与火焰要求。普通火焰无法炼化所有材料。
为炼器鼎提供火焰
在鼎下方放置可用火焰。打开炼器鼎后，开始炼制并催动火焰升温。
查看突破后果
部分突破失败不会直接恢复原状。打开修炼状态查看当前境界、伤势及重新突破所需条件。
